event: The word at the camp is that the creature at Depth 3 is bleeding; Orla Vess writes seeping.
Her notes: luminescent fluid, continuous, left flank wound, a delayed strike since Death #20.
Two days at the camp, she asks Osren what the entrants did to the creature, in order.
Three times through it: Brand, Keystone, Joint, Cull. Four tools, four years.
She has done this work before: reading accumulated damage to find the way through it.
She once found and finished a cave predator lamed by a farmer's trap.
"The knife. Where is it now?" On the floor near the creature, Osren says.
The fluid loss is steady, and the wound has been visible from thirty meters for two deaths.
"So it's not closing." "No. It's not closing."
It is 342 years old and has never been wounded: it does not know how to heal.
A second effects crate has been started beside the first.
"You'll be number twenty-three." "Death number twenty-three. I'm aware."
She enters at dawn, with full light and hours enough to do the job correctly.
The Gullet registers her like a room registering a door; she moves through without sentiment.
The Ledger: Depth 2, the Marrow Warrens, Resolve +1, now 19.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Marrow Warrens, Resolve +1

event: The Ledger names her The Finish, with the Gift Finishing Blow: one strike that completes weakness.
Its Cost is The Long Approach: she cannot rush or run; the work has a pace.
The Ledger reads Vitality 16, Resolve 19, Attunement 14, Fortune 11.
Compelled: She believes she chose. She is not wrong.
Gift and Cost are two sides of her method: correctly, or not at all.
She follows the surveyor's charcoal and the pressed signs as waypoints, not texts.
The Ledger: Depth 3, the Still Garden, Resolve +1, now 20.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Still Garden, Resolve +1

event: She stops at the threshold to assess, not from fear.
The Patient stands asymmetric, loading its strong side like a building settling on a lost support.
From fifty meters she sees the crack, the dried residue, and the seeping penetration.
The Patient is looking at her; its caution means she has a window, not a wide one.
She angles in, staying just outside twenty-five meters, reading as she walks.
Its hesitation is longer than reported: every bypassing entrant taught it waiting is safe.
She is going to teach it something else.
At thirty meters she reads the damage: blow, widening, penetration, a reactive wound.
The tissue at the wound is biological, and there its central process lies nearest the surface.
She understands the path: not the shell, the wound.
The Long Approach holds her to her working pace toward a 342-year-old predator.
Twenty-eight meters: its weight shifts forward, and the strike does not come.
Twenty-six: she can read the Brand's note: if three, try left center seam first.
At twenty-five The Patient steps sideways, turning its wounded flank away: guarding.
She adjusts her line to keep the penetration point in view.
Twenty-three: the spear, the plumb line, the chisel, and Dorric's knife six meters off.
She is closer than Dorric was.
At twenty-two meters she activates Finishing Blow.
It shows the path: through the wound, past where the knife went, angled from below.
Nineteen, eighteen: it moves, and she adjusts only as fast as her pace allows.
At fifteen meters it begins a lunge and aborts it seven meters from her.
She walks the last seven meters at her pace while it makes a low grinding resonance.
She reaches the wound and picks up Dorric's knife without breaking pace.
One hand at the wound's upper margin, Finishing Blow completes its reading.
She drives the knife in sixteen degrees off the first line, toward the tissue at the base.
The grinding grows louder, and the seep becomes a flow.
The creature lurches away three steps, its cracked flank failing: twelve meters in two seconds.
The knife has pulled free and lies on the floor between them.
It is alive: the path is open, but the damage is not yet sufficient.
She walks back toward the wound site at her pace.
It recovers faster than she can close: it has retreated from pain, not from her.
Its weight recentres; it is not dying, it is deciding.
She keeps walking: the pace is the work.
It turns to face her, fluid running down its left flank, the crack wider where she struck.
It stands between her and the wound, and its hesitation is ending.
It strikes with full commitment across twelve meters.
She was walking toward it at the only pace she has; she had not done it wrong.
She dies standing.

changes.note: Orla is killed by The Patient, Vitality 16 to 0

event: The death report: Orla Vess, the Finish, Depth 3; the Gift complete, the work not.
The pace was correct, and the pace was insufficient: both true.
Kill nine: the first time The Patient has killed someone who hurt it.
The wound is worse: fluid loss about forty percent higher; the knife back on the floor.
Five in sequence now: mapped, cracked, widened, penetrated, deepened.
The fifth instrument was a knife someone else left: she used what was already there.
Her Memory Crystal is red, the second red: The Patient has its own crystal family.
Compelled; voluntary entrants stand at six of twenty-three.
A new category: Consequent. She came for the wound Dorric left.
Each death changes what the next has reason to do: the chain designed itself.
A successful action without a successful outcome: the Ledger names it Complete, not Finished.
The format is now: whatever matters most, first. Here, the damage.
Through the Reflection the Maw finds a feeling it cannot name.
Five entrants, five tools, each building on the last, none intending to.
The Maw built the system; the entrants built the sequence.
The Patient lives, its core intact; nine kills, one wound, deepened five times.
The Maw does not know whether a wound like this can kill a creature that old.
Spear, plumb line, chisel, knife: the Garden is accumulating.
Osren records the glow: red, six seconds, the second red. Purpose: to finish the job.
One crystal into the second effects box; it is a third full.
Twenty-three names on the wall; the newest still settling: ORLA VESS — FIVE COMPLETE.
He closes the book as morning begins: 977 remain.
